name: opencaptions
description: Animated word-by-word captions for your videos, from Claude, Cursor or any MCP client, or the command line. Runs on your computer, or on your own OpenCaptions server.
long_description:
Ask Claude to caption a video, and it transcribes the speech, styles it with one of the looks, and saves the captioned video next to the original. It can also read the captions back, fix a misheard word, and export SRT or VTT subtitles.

It runs on your computer: the speech model and the caption engine are local, and the video is never uploaded. The first caption downloads the speech model (about 700 MB, once). It needs [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/download.html), which reads and writes the video: `brew install ffmpeg`.

To use your own OpenCaptions server instead (every language, Whisper models, a GPU, the web editor), fill in its address and an API key from its Account page. Leave them empty to work on this computer.
